# Exercise the built-in block commands and nested block execution.
foreach foo A B {
	foreach bar 1 2 {
		exec sh -c 'printf "%s %s\n" "$foo" "$bar" >> blocks.out'
	}
}

when true {
	exec sh -c 'printf "when true\n" >> blocks.out'
}
when false {
	exec sh -c 'printf "when false\n" >> blocks.out'
}
unless false {
	exec sh -c 'printf "unless false\n" >> blocks.out'
}
unless 1 {
	exec sh -c 'printf "unless true\n" >> blocks.out'
}

repeat i 3 {
	exec sh -c 'printf "repeat %s\n" "$i" >> blocks.out'
}

env BLOCK_TEMP=
withenv BLOCK_TEMP=temporary {
	exec sh -c 'printf "withenv %s\n" "$BLOCK_TEMP" >> blocks.out'
	env BLOCK_PERSIST=persisted
}
env BLOCK_TEMP
stdout '^BLOCK_TEMP=$'
env BLOCK_PERSIST
stdout '^BLOCK_PERSIST=persisted$'

[testtrue] {
	echo condition-true
}
stdout '^condition-true$'
[testfalse] {
	echo condition-false
}
stdout '^condition-true$'

[testtrue] foreach item ran {
	echo condition-command-$item
}
stdout '^condition-command-ran$'
[testfalse] foreach item skipped-command {
	echo condition-command-$item
}
stdout '^condition-command-ran$'

env INLINE_FOREACH=
line 'foreach item A B { env INLINE_FOREACH=$item }'
env INLINE_FOREACH
stdout '^INLINE_FOREACH=B$'

env INLINE_WHEN=initial
line 'when 1 { env INLINE_WHEN=ran }'
env INLINE_WHEN
stdout '^INLINE_WHEN=ran$'
line 'when false { env INLINE_WHEN=wrong }'
env INLINE_WHEN
stdout '^INLINE_WHEN=ran$'

env INLINE_UNLESS=initial
line 'unless false { env INLINE_UNLESS=ran }'
env INLINE_UNLESS
stdout '^INLINE_UNLESS=ran$'
line 'unless true { env INLINE_UNLESS=wrong }'
env INLINE_UNLESS
stdout '^INLINE_UNLESS=ran$'

env INLINE_REPEAT=
line 'repeat i 2 { env INLINE_REPEAT=$i }'
env INLINE_REPEAT
stdout '^INLINE_REPEAT=1$'

env INLINE_TEMP=
line 'withenv INLINE_TEMP=temporary { env INLINE_WITHENV=$INLINE_TEMP }'
env INLINE_TEMP
stdout '^INLINE_TEMP=$'
env INLINE_WITHENV
stdout '^INLINE_WITHENV=temporary$'

retry --max-retries=2 {
	retrytest --not-empty=xyz abc
}
rm retrytest
retry --until-failure --max-retries=2 {
	retrytest --not-empty=xyz abc
}
rm retrytest
line 'retry --max-retries=2 { retrytest --not-empty=xyz abc }'
rm retrytest
line 'retry --until-failure --max-retries=2 { retrytest --not-empty=xyz abc }'

rm retrytest
* {
	retrytest --not-empty=xyz abc
}
! {
	cat missing-block-file.txt
}

! foreach item missing {
	cat missing-block-file.txt
}

exec sh -c 'printf "done\n" >> blocks.out'
cmp blocks.out blocks_expected.txt
echo block-modifiers-ok
stdout '^block-modifiers-ok$'

# Execute inline blocks directly, mixing semicolons, comments, and expansions.
foreach item direct last { env DIRECT=$item }; env DIRECT
stdout '^DIRECT=last$'
when true { # A comment after the opening delimiter is valid.
 foreach item A B { env DIRECT=${item} } # Closing comments are valid too.
}
env DIRECT
stdout '^DIRECT=B$'
! { foreach item missing { cat missing-block-file.txt } }
foreach item { env DIRECT=wrong }
repeat i 0 { env DIRECT=wrong }
env DIRECT
stdout '^DIRECT=B$'

withenv BLOCK_TEMP=outer {
 withenv BLOCK_TEMP=inner { env BLOCK_TEMP=changed }
 env BLOCK_TEMP
 stdout '^BLOCK_TEMP=outer$'
 env BLOCK_TEMP=changed
}
env BLOCK_TEMP
stdout '^BLOCK_TEMP=$'

-- blocks_expected.txt --
A 1
A 2
B 1
B 2
when true
unless false
repeat 0
repeat 1
repeat 2
withenv temporary
done
